Office 365 for Business

Enhance your team’s efficiency using the collaborative tools provided by Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365.

By choosing the right plan for your company and employees, you ensure more effective project management, smooth communication between team members, and a more integrated and productive work environment.

Contact us

Choose a plan that adapts to your Company and Employees

Contact us to help you choose the best solution in terms of pricing and features tailored to your business.

Microsoft 365 Business Basic

(annual subscription - automatically renews)
Price does not include VAT.

  • Identity, access, and user management for up to 300 employees
  • Customized business email
  • Web and mobile versions of Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook
  • Chat, calls, and video conferencing in Microsoft Teams
  • 1 TB of cloud storage per user
  • Over 10 additional apps for your business needs (Microsoft Bookings, Planner, Forms, and others)
  • Automatic spam and malware filtering
  • Phone and web support anytime
  • Copilot for Microsoft 365, available as an add-on
